Synopsis:
    Reform UK's Nigel Farage and France's National Rally chief Jordan Bardella signed a memorandum of understanding at Reform's Birmingham conference, pledging a bilateral framework to detain and return Channel boat migrants if both parties gain power. The pact envisions shared border security costs and full repatriation to countries of origin. Both parties are polling strongly — RN's Le Pen is forecast to win France's April/May 2027 presidential race, while Reform is tied with Labour ahead of the UK's 2029 election deadline. The agreement is politically significant but entirely conditional on future electoral outcomes in both countries.

The formal pact adds some specificity but is conditional on two separate electoral outcomes, making it low-urgency and largely anticipated by political observers.
